def process(normalize_violation) -> pd.DataFrame:
    yearly = normalize_violation.groupby('Year').agg(
        total_samples=('Violation', 'count'),
        violations=('Violation', lambda x: (x == 'yes').sum())
    ).reset_index()
    yearly['exceedance_rate'] = yearly['violations'] / yearly['total_samples']
    return yearly
